messages.subject: RE: Letter Before Action - Bracken / Marldon effluent system
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We act for Marldon Process Systems Limited. Liability is denied. Our client's position is that the system was correctly designed to the loading disclosed at enquiry (1,200 mg/l COD) and that the failures were caused by your client operating the plant well beyond that basis. We also rely on the limitation and exclusion provisions in our client's standard terms. A full letter of response follows.

Marcus Thackeray
Partner | Thackeray Wolfe LLP
